task_name: Collect Factory Output, Re-queue Wood, and Visit Daniel's City While Waiting on Timers

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When factory timers finish and commercial stores are busy crafting long-duration items (Planks 24m, Hammer 13m).
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Collecting finished Wood and Metal and re-queuing Wood keeps raw material production active while visiting Daniel's City allows inspecting high-level city layouts and checking if his Trade Depot has refreshed.
preconditions: Finished Wood and Metal on factories
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Collect and re-queue at the northern factories, then use the Friends menu to visit Daniel's City and return home.

steps.who: floating Wood and Metal on the northern Small Factories
steps.briefing: collect the finished materials and drag Wood into the empty slots.

steps.who: Friends icon in the bottom-left corner

steps.briefing: travel to Daniel's City and explore his city layout.

steps.who: blue Home icon in the top-left corner
